verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const rd=(p)=>{if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error("indeterminate: missing "+p);process.exit(79)}return fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8")};const slice=(t,name)=>{const i=t.indexOf("export async function "+name);if(i<0)return null;const j=t.indexOf("export async function ",i+10);return t.slice(i,j<0?t.length:j)};const q=String.fromCharCode(39);const p=rd("app/(main)/admin/crew-tasks/page.tsx");const t=rd("app/(main)/admin/actions.ts");const r=slice(t,"rejectVerification")||"";const byNull=new RegExp("\\.is\\("+q+"verified_by"+q+",\\s*null\\)");if(byNull.test(p)){console.error("SCAN-752: the verification queue still selects crew_completions by verified_by null and limits before filtering on requires_verification, so fifty ordinary completions hide every held one and their Zaps never release.");process.exit(1)}if(byNull.test(r)){console.error("SCAN-752: rejectVerification still keys its delete on verified_by null instead of verified_at null, so an auto-verified and already credited completion can be deleted.");process.exit(1)}'

append.detail: The admin verification queue selected crew_completions by verified_by null, limited to 50, then dropped rows whose task does not require verification in JS. Ordinary completions never carry verified_by (the atomic insert sets neither column, and only the leader method writes it), so once fifty ordinary completions existed the page read fifty ordinary rows, filtered them all away, rendered an empty queue for good and the held Zaps never released. The read now lives in lib/crew/verification-queue.ts (listHeldCompletions): it keys on the real held marker verified_at null, joins the task with crew_tasks!task_id!inner and filters task.requires_verification = true in SQL before the limit, so circle-scoped held completions surface too; the JS post-filters are gone. rejectVerification now deletes keyed on verified_at null instead of verified_by null, so an auto-verified, already credited completion can never be deleted. Pinned by lib/crew/verification-queue.test.ts (filters, order before limit, no verified_by) and app/(main)/admin/reject-verification.test.ts (delete guarded by verified_at null).
